name: A King's Tribute
summary: In Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard answers Sara Balloo's plea with a lasting tribute to Sully, her fallen husband. He sends you to relay his royal commission to Grand Mason Marblesten.

sections.title: A Sovereign's Burden
sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard hears Sara Balloo's plea and gives the grieving widow his attention. He knows common folk may struggle to understand the harsh needs of war, yet every soldier who fights beneath the Alliance banner weighs on his conscience. Magni cannot undo a death on the front lines. He can make sure Sully Balloo's sacrifice is remembered.

sections.title: The Mason's Chisel
sections.body: King Magni chooses a stone memorial for Sully instead of empty words. He appoints you custodian of his royal will and sends you across Ironforge to Grand Mason Marblesten. The master stonemason receives the King's personal commission and prepares to carve the memory of a fallen defender into stone.

faq.answer: Sully Balloo was a dwarven soldier who died fighting for the Alliance in the defense of the Thandol Span. After learning of his death, his widow, Sara Balloo, petitioned King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Why does King Magni commission a memorial?
faq.answer: King Magni carries the weight of every dwarven life lost in the Alliance's ongoing struggles. He cannot restore Sully to his widow, so he commissions an enduring monument to honor the soldier's courage.
Grand Mason Marblesten is Ironforge's master stoneworker, entrusted with major civic and royal building projects throughout the city. King Magni relies on him to sculpt Sully Balloo's memorial.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You travel within Ironforge, beginning at the High Seat with King Magni Bronzebeard and going on to Grand Mason Marblesten elsewhere in the capital.
Before this, you complete 'Sara Balloo's Plea' by delivering the widow's heartfelt letter directly to King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Is this memorial only for Sully Balloo?
faq.answer: The tribute bears Sully Balloo's name and is meant to console his widow, Sara. It also honors every dwarven fighter who dies serving the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see King Magni's devotion to his people: even the lowliest dwarven foot soldier is remembered by the throne.
As an Alliance fighter, you know the fallen at the Thandol Span gave their lives guarding crucial supply lines between Khaz Modan and the northern kingdoms.
